<Why>
The overview shows every module as a tile with its progress, and the Continue button moves on to the next module when one is finished. This step gives the sample a second module to show that.
</Why>

<Idea>
Modules follow one another in the order their files give.
</Idea>

<Question id="q-m91-s01" answer="a">
What decides the order of modules?

- The order field in each module file

  Right: lower numbers come first.

- The file names

  The order field decides.

- The number of steps

  Size does not change the order.

- The date the module was written

  Dates play no part.
</Question>
